reasoning: 驗證目標：快轉的推進速率依三段階梯遞增——前 3 秒為 10 秒增量（每 0.5 秒 5 秒）、其後 7 秒為 20 秒增量（每 0.5 秒 10 秒）、之後為 60 秒增量（每 0.5 秒 30 秒），直到快轉結束或到達緩衝區終點。關鍵情境條件：兩個換檔時點（第 3 秒、第 10 秒）——這是條文給出的明確邊界。為什麼這樣切：驗證對象是這兩個邊界與三段速率，設計方法採邊界值分析；三段是同一觸發（持續快轉）的連續結果，依 §5.7 併為一條 TC 的多條 ER。只驗總推進量而不驗分段，無法區分本條與「固定速率快轉」的實作（§7），因此程序在每個換檔點量測。刻意略過：條文的結束條件（快轉結束或到達緩衝區終點）分別由 088 與 089 覆蓋。

tcs.tc_title: Fast forward rate steps up at three and at ten seconds
tcs.test_item: The HU shall allow Fast Fowarding in 10-second increments (5-second every 0.5 second) in audio content for the first 3 seconds, in 20-second increments (10-second every 0.5 second) for 7 seconds, and in 60-second increments (30-second every 0.5 second) thereafter until the Fast Forward function is ended or the end of the buffer has been reached
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The buffer holds enough content that fast forwarding for 15 seconds does not reach real time
5. Playback is positioned at a known point inside the buffer
tcs.input_test_data:
Rate phase 1: first 3 seconds of the request — 5 seconds of content every 0.5 second
Rate phase 2: the following 7 seconds — 10 seconds of content every 0.5 second
Rate phase 3: after 10 seconds — 30 seconds of content every 0.5 second
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Note the playback position and start a stopwatch as Fast Forward is requested
2. Read the playback position 3 seconds after the request starts
3. Read the playback position 10 seconds after the request starts
4. Read the playback position 15 seconds after the request starts, then release the request
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fast forward request is accepted from the known position
2. The playback position has advanced by about 30 seconds of content, the phase 1 rate over 3 seconds
3. The playback position has advanced by about 170 seconds of content in total, which adds the phase 2 rate over the following 7 seconds
4. The playback position has advanced by about 470 seconds of content in total, which adds the phase 3 rate over the last 5 seconds
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
